title: A new puzzle game I’m working on
author: blackwidowink
selftext:
Hey guys, making a new puzzle game and wouldn’t mind some feedback if anyone has time. My thoughts behind creating this was “what if you rotated the board instead of the pieces?” and it just evolved from there. Using Astrocade.com for the game code and assets and Producer.ai for the music. 

You can try it [here](https://www.astrocade.com/games/hexfall/01KBK27Z49SVFYV15JSYEJRR99?sharedByPlayer=blackwidowink).

comments.author: surpurdurd
comments.body: Nice! I'd work a little more on the flow/rhythm, mainly looking to minimize the time a player is waiting for something to happen. Escalation of difficulty should be smooth and consistent, seemed like a pretty sudden jump when 2x double tiles appeared at the end. Also might be cool to add a ghost tile or highlight that shows specifically where the tile is about to end up. Overall looks good though, keep going

replies.author: surpurdurd
replies.body: Also wanted to add, the ghost/highlight would be super helpful for the rotating tiles.since rotating the board seems to rotate the tiles coming in as well, once you start rotating double and triple tiles, knowing how they're going to land is less intuitive and more important.

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: It is actually fun. Though it confuses on where should it face, I guess that an added security so presence of mind should always be present. Hahaha I like it. Would you be able to share it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) so other users can also give their feedback?

replies.author: blackwidowink
replies.body: Oh wow, that’s crazy! I guess everything HAS been done before

replies.author: outerdead
replies.body: I loved that game, and haven't seen anything like it, and it probably could use some expansion!

replies.author: blackwidowink
replies.body: What do you think of my version so far? What would you add?

comments.author: Bully098
comments.body: Hey I have a question. Did you make this game only using prompts?

replies.author: blackwidowink
replies.body: Yes I did. I have a pretty busy schedule, so I create all my games on my iPhone while on the go using Astrocade.
